简介: Neelam Bakshi is an actress well known for her diverse talent. Her recent film work includes Sweeteness in the Belly, (2019), Azaar (2018), Der Koch (2014), Trap for Cinderella (2013), Dreams of a life (2011), shoot on sight (2007), Namaste London (2007), Saxon (2007), The inspector Lynley Mysteries (2006) , Murder of Steven Lawrence , various episodes of The Bill and many more TV and film roles. She is well sought after.
